gallery.title: File:Teatro Romano de Caesaraugusta.JPG
gallery.description: Theater from the Roman era, built in the first half of the 1st century AD. C., with the governments of Tiberius and Claudius in the city as Caesar Augusta, current Zaragoza. It had a capacity for about six thousand spectators. It followed the model of the Marcelo theater in Rome and was in use until the 3rd century when its materials were reused to build walls and other buildings. Zaragoza, in Aragon
